<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <title>Pelican riding a bicycle</title>
  <!-- 背景 -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#eaf6fb"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="48" r="22" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <rect y="252" width="400" height="48" fill="#e6d7b4"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="252" x2="400" y2="252" stroke="#cdbb8f" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- 速度线 -->
  <g stroke="#a8cede" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="46" y1="185" x2="76" y2="185"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="212" x2="72" y2="212"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="239" x2="78" y2="239"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 车架 -->
  <g stroke="#d9534f" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="120" y1="215" x2="185" y2="215"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="215" x2="172" y2="150"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="215" x2="176" y2="158"/>
    <line x1="176" y1="158" x2="262" y2="163"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="215" x2="262" y2="163"/>
    <line x1="262" y1="163" x2="280" y2="215"/>
    <line x1="262" y1="163" x2="250" y2="132"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 车把 -->
  <path d="M250 132 L238 125 L226 130" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- 车座 -->
  <line x1="172" y1="150" x2="169" y2="140" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="151" y="134" width="36" height="8" rx="4" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- 后轮（转动） -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="120" cy="215" r="38" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6"/>
    <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="120" y1="180" x2="120" y2="250"/>
      <line x1="85" y1="215" x2="155" y2="215"/>
      <line x1="95" y1="190" x2="145" y2="240"/>
      <line x1="145" y1="190" x2="95" y2="240"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 120 215" to="360 120 215" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="120" cy="215" r="4" fill="#222"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 前轮（转动） -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="280" cy="215" r="38" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6"/>
    <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="280" y1="180" x2="280" y2="250"/>
      <line x1="245" y1="215" x2="315" y2="215"/>
      <line x1="255" y1="190" x2="305" y2="240"/>
      <line x1="305" y1="190" x2="255" y2="240"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 280 215" to="360 280 215" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="280" cy="215" r="4" fill="#222"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 曲柄与踏板 -->
  <circle cx="185" cy="215" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="185" y1="215" x2="197" y2="226" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="185" y1="215" x2="173" y2="204" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="191" y="222" width="13" height="5" fill="#222"/>
  <rect x="166" y="199" width="13" height="5" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- 鹈鹕 -->
  <g>
    <!-- 尾羽 -->
    <path d="M155 106 L126 94 L150 124 Z" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 腿 -->
    <g stroke="#e8960c" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="180" y1="132" x2="190" y2="218"/>
      <line x1="196" y1="128" x2="196" y2="222"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 脚 -->
    <path d="M182 220 L200 220 L196 226 Z" fill="#e8960c"/>
    <path d="M188 224 L206 224 L202 230 Z" fill="#e8960c"/>
    <!-- 身体 -->
    <ellipse cx="192" cy="112" rx="42" ry="26" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 翅膀 -->
    <ellipse cx="194" cy="114" rx="24" ry="13" fill="#eee" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 脖子 -->
    <path d="M220 100 C230 96 234 88 236 78" stroke="#fdfdfd" stroke-width="12" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 头 -->
    <circle cx="244" cy="74" r="14" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- 眼睛 -->
    <circle cx="249" cy="70" r="2.6" fill="#222"/>
    <!-- 喉囊 -->
    <path d="M256 84 Q272 106 301 81 Z" fill="#ffce7a" stroke="#e8960c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- 上喙 -->
    <path d="M256 68 L302 80 L256 84 Z" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#d98a0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
</svg>
